title: AB167 (2019 Regular): Authorizes the possession of a handgun in a motor vehicle that is on the property of certain educational entities or child care facilities in certain circumstances. (BDR 15-97)

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Nevada) (gun-policy Stage 5, Nevada); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Nevada text (As introduced, official copy, https://archive.leg.state.nv.us/Session/80th2019/Bills/AB/AB167.pdf; sha256 bbdfc0ffc67d4358d53fd3f59f57d5ff396dd241b6195f04f207f62dc654a625)
provenance.note: As-filed (introduced) text, no passage vote recorded. NRS 202.265 changes in this version also strike old wording (a 'vehicle' definition and the word 'vehicle' in subsection 1, and renumbering letters); those struck words are not quoted.

operative_text:
Section 1 (NRS 202.265): (b) A handgun on the property of the Nevada System of Higher Education or a private or public school or child care facility by a person who holds a permit to carry a concealed firearm that was issued pursuant to the provisions of NRS 202.3653 to 202.369, inclusive, if the handgun remains out of common observation and is: (1) Inside a motor vehicle, other than a school bus, that is: (I) Occupied; or (II) Unoccupied and locked; or (2) Stored in a locked container that is affixed securely to a motor vehicle, other than a school bus.
Section 2 (NRS 202.3673): (2) Possesses a handgun in accordance with the provisions of paragraph (b) of subsection 3 of NRS 202.265.
